goal: Allow users to manually rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions via RPC or the GUI
Avoids having to manually find raw hex and call sendrawtransaction when a transaction drops
agreement: Unaddressed objection: fails with empty error if feerate exceeds maxfeerate, no author reply (fametrano)
Broad concept support for giving users manual rebroadcast capabilities (mzumsande, polespinasa, vasild)
Approach approval with suggestions on locking cleanup and depth caching (vasild, pseudoramdom)
Approval without rationale from an account with no project history is not counted as support (psychemist)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it adds direct wallet RPC and GUI controls for transactions that drop from mempools
Saves wallet users from cumbersome manual raw transaction extraction and resubmission
